entries.text: 大約１年多前……
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_system_01

entries.text: 對不起……\n我是不是做過頭了……[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_01

entries.text: 拜託妳用實戰的方式\n來訓練的是我們啊。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_akuboss_02

entries.text: 閣下不需謝罪。[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_dokuboss_01

entries.text: 託枇琶閣下的特訓的福，\n在下正朝登峰造極之路直奔。[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_dokuboss_02

entries.text: 要是沒有枇琶妳的話，\n我的寶可夢也沒辦法進化了。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_fairyboss_01

entries.text: 真老大也說過還好有枇琶姐在，\n我們才有辦法對抗霸凌別人的學生。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_honooboss_01

entries.text: 真的超感謝的唷。\n枇琶是天星隊的榜樣！[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_akuboss_03

entries.text: 呵呵，\n才沒有那回事……！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_03

entries.text: 不過啊，都練習４個小時了，\n我差不多要到極限了……[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_fairyboss_02

entries.text: 啊，對不起！\n那麼，大家休息一下！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_04

entries.text: 在下和大家都是輪流做訓練，\n但枇琶閣下妳總是在指導別人……\r\n在下擔心妳的身體會吃不消。[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_dokuboss_03

entries.text: 最近呀，不管我有多累有多想哭，\n都能撐過去。[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_07

entries.text: 我們不是模仿道館徽章，\n一起做了天星隊的徽章嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_08

entries.text: 我只要看到那個徽章，\n力量就會不斷湧上……\r\n我就能打起幹勁加油！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_21

entries.text: 雖然我……加油了……\n但……還是失敗了……[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_09

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳很強。\n雖然隊規本就這麼規定，\r\n但我自己也希望[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳擁有它。[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_10

entries.text: 這個招式就像是我的信念一樣，\n也希望[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳能好好運用。[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_waza_01

entries.text: 和[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳對戰之後我明白了。\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳不是一個討人厭的傢伙。[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_13

entries.text: 從[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的寶可夢們看著[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的眼神，\n我明白了這一點。[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_14

entries.text: 不過，能拜託[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳把視線稍微挪開一下嗎？\n現在我有點難過……[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_15

entries.text: 她是在大門前和[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳對戰過的隊員。\n我有話想問她，所以讓她來這裡了。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_02

entries.text: [EMPTY 68]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 68]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_18

entries.text: [EMPTY 68]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_04

entries.text: [EMPTY 68]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_05

entries.text: [EMPTY 68]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_19

entries.text: [EMPTY 68]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_06

entries.text: [EMPTY 68]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_20

entries.text: [EMPTY 68]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_02

entries.text: [EMPTY 68]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_07

entries.text: ……有話想問我？[VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_03

entries.text: 和其他手下相比，\n妳對待老大的方式不太一樣。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_08

entries.text: 可以告訴我理由嗎？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_09

entries.text: 你的觀察力真好。\n……好吧，我告訴你。[VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_04

entries.text: 我以前看枇琶很不順眼。[VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_05

entries.text: [EMPTY 68]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_10

entries.text: [EMPTY 68]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_06

entries.text: 她長得漂亮，運動全能，\n還是個優秀的訓練家。[VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_07

entries.text: 枇琶在入學之後，\n立刻就成了學院的人氣寵兒。[VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_08

entries.text: 超越了在那之前\n最受大家喜愛的我……[VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_09

entries.text: 所以，妳開始找她麻煩……？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_11

entries.text: 是的。\n我號召同學們做了很多有的沒有的……\r\n當時的我真是太愚蠢了。[VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_10

entries.text: [EMPTY 68]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_11

entries.text: [EMPTY 68]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_12

entries.text: 但是，那終究只是小孩子的遊戲。\n玩膩了，就開始想要尋找別的刺激。[VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_12

entries.text: 於是很快地班上下一個\n霸凌的對象就變成了我。[VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_13

entries.text: [EMPTY 68]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_13

entries.text: ……這就是因果報應吧。\n但是，枇琶她向這麼愚蠢的我\r\n伸出了援手。[VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_14

entries.text: 「沒有容身之地，很痛苦吧？」\n她這麼跟我說，然後邀我加入天星隊。[VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_15

entries.text: 邀請曾經霸凌自己的罪魁禍首……\n她真的是一個了不起的女性。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_14

entries.text: ……她真的很了不起。\n我加入天星隊之後，一直過得很開心。[VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_16

entries.text: 但也有天星隊在霸凌別人的傳聞……[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_15

entries.text: 你聽完剛剛的那些話，\n還會那麼想嗎？[VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_17

entries.text: 能有現在的我，\n都是託枇琶和天星隊的福。[VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_18

entries.text: 不要奪走……\n我們重要的寶物。[VAR 0x0114(003F)]
entries.label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_19
